paragraphs: Mentioned in Avot de-Rabbi Natan 29:3, saying: “One who is awake at night engaged in words of Torah—it is a good sign for him.”[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: פכ״ט-ג is read as chapter 29 section 3 without selecting an A/B recension or independently checked edition; older machine פכ״מדג differs. The Hebrew locator remains available rather than silently treating a verified scheme as established.
ד״ת is words of Torah; each phrase of the awake-at-night/good-sign saying remains at source force. The heading title remains R'.
The trailing gimel in פכ״ט-ג is read as section 3 here, but its precise locator function and the A/B recension remain unverified; the reading is not a newly established edition scheme.
